title: Enterprises power agentic workflows in Cloudflare Agent Cloud with OpenAI
summary: Cloudflare brings OpenAI’s GPT-5.4 and Codex to Agent Cloud, enabling enterprises to build, deploy, and scale AI agents for real-world tasks with speed and security.
body: Cloudflare brings OpenAI’s GPT-5.4 and Codex to Agent Cloud, enabling enterprises to build, deploy, and scale AI agents for real-world tasks with speed and security.
summaryZh: Cloudflare宣布在Agent Cloud中集成OpenAI的GPT-5.4及Codex模型，旨在为企业提供构建、部署和扩展AI Agent的平台。此次合作结合了Cloudflare的边缘计算能力与OpenAI的高级模型，重点解决企业在Agent应用中的速度与安全性问题，支持企业级工作流的自动化与智能化升级。

aiReview.reasonZh: Cloudflare与OpenAI合作将GPT-5.4集成至Agent Cloud，推动了企业级Agent的规模化部署。
